findings.title: Reviewed need and buyer can be promoted without a source reference
findings.contract: docs/CUSTOMER_FIRST_V1.md requires evidence-backed need and a sourced buyer chain.
findings.evidence: Fresh temporary SQLite Store probe saved REVIEWED scope='temporary power' and buyer='Buyer A' with source_url='', only self-entered excerpt/reviewer text. Returned gate need=VERIFIED, buyer=KNOWN. The UI explicitly labels Source URL optional. There is no other source locator field.
findings.repair_target: Require a traceable source reference for reviewed scope and buyer evidence, including a supported local document reference if offline evidence is intended; retain UNKNOWN when absent. Add a persistence and gate regression.

findings.title: Locked fuel record accepts coordination notes
findings.contract: docs/CUSTOMER_FIRST_V1.md requires fuel coordination to stay blocked until verified need and an actual understood customer conversation.
findings.evidence: Fresh temporary SQLite Store saved fuel.status=NOT_STARTED with notes='Call fuel supplier; reserve delivery before customer conversation'. Returned gate need=UNKNOWN, conversation=NONE, fuel_unlocked=false; the notes persisted. UI disables notes while locked, but server validation does not.
findings.repair_target: Reject new or edited fuel coordination notes while locked, while retaining notes saved during an earlier lawful unlocked state after a later contradiction. Alternatively, move pre-gate research notes to a separate field. Test both initial lock and later demotion at the server/store boundary.

findings.title: Browser displays unlocked fuel when buyer evidence is unresolved
findings.contract: The customer-first queue must show honest buyer and fuel states; unknown or contradicted buyer authority must relock fuel.
findings.evidence: Independent Node evaluation of the actual localGate function with reviewed buyer A plus a second active UNKNOWN buyer item, a buyer-linked person, understood interaction, and reviewed temporary scope returned buyer=KNOWN and fuel_unlocked=true. Python gate on the equivalent document returned buyer=UNKNOWN and fuel_unlocked=false. The browser filters the UNKNOWN buyer item before deciding the gate; the server requires every active buyer item REVIEWED.
findings.repair_target: Use server-authoritative gate state for the displayed workflow, or make the client calculation exactly match the server for unresolved and contradicted evidence. Add a browser-visible regression.
